scope: Native CLI foreground OpenRouter account-catalogue composition with invocation-key/scope/proxy and passive/offline separation
implementation: resolveStartupProvider explicitly refreshes actual OpenRouterProvider instances on concerned foreground scopes/selection, not by provider label or from passive listing. Glob matching reuses Core's model resolver with declared identities. Invocation key is prebound before discovery for known native scopes, including a uniquely matched provider-prefix glob; unrelated/ambiguous namespaces are not retargeted by credential contents. Explicit-key paths never refresh an old stored-key instance. Final selected instance refreshes after ordinary key/factory override and before model admission. SDK private snapshot is not copied to replacement instances; network/proxy/caller options are retained. Static offline/cold metadata and prior factory/alias behavior remain separate, with no new disk cache, background discovery, credential command/login/refresh or Server/Settings personalization.
proof: Six new resolver cases cover real effective C body/context/cost from foreground key, passive catalogue no GET, stored versus invocation-key glob scope plus cold exact-key proxy, provider-prefix glob account rebind without old-key query, known-empty exact/glob refusal and offline cold declarations, unrelated scopes/Mock factory nonpromotion, and held-catalogue caller retirement/late-body release. Four actual emitted print/JSON/RPC/TTY cases use PKCE permanent key then two separate processes, each GET/models/user before real C SSE, cap9000/context64000/key-owned5/20 rates→10-token/$0.00008 once per assistant, privacy/logout/no extra request. Stronger existing print case also proves actual --list-models is passive; an unchanged actual offline native RPC C case retains393 declared descriptors and exactly one inference request. Existing proxy-override composition case now mocks precise404/models/user fallback with the invocation key, not a weakened offline substitute.
freshness: Foreground selection refreshes explicitly. Passive reads/--list-models and offline cold selection do not personalize or load a persisted personal-account cache; their physical metadata/rates remain declared, not a verified account entitlement/current billing claim. SDK in-memory known-empty and key/header/base ownership remain authoritative for that instance; no old snapshot is borrowed by invocation overrides.
